policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-four goals now exceed Drury's and Missouri S&T's together, the next two on the chart; the only conference side they have met is the only side to have held them.
William Jewell have lost all four of their matches and have yet to score; they have conceded seven, the last two of them at home to Missouri S&T.
